properties.name: A batch of tool calls runs through the door in one process, under one approval and with one export at the end
properties.statement:
Step 6 of the plan to make the `--call` door work for an agent that cannot use MCP (Anthony, 2026-10-01; his idea 6 in using_call.md). A capture burst (genesis seeds dozens of nodes) is otherwise dozens of approvals, store opens and exports.

MUST:
- A batch form reads JSON lines of {tool, args} and runs them in order against one open store.
- It stops at the first refusal and says which line, leaving the earlier lines written and named.
- It exports once at the end when any line wrote.
- It never carries a settle past the owner's word: the store's own signature check applies to every line.
